verses.english: “There are these two kinds of sympathy.
Sympathy in things of the flesh and sympathy in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of sympathy.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ dvinnaṁ anukampānaṁ yadidaṁ dhammānukampā”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of sympathy is sympathy in the teaching.”
